blocks.text: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) lungs ki ek aham beemari hai.

COPD lungs ki ek chronic inflammatory (lambi sozish wali) beemari hai. Is ki aam wajahein tambaku noshi (smoking), aur nuqsan deh pollutants (aaloodgi) aur chemicals ke dhuen mein lamba arsa rehna hain. Kuch thode logon mein genetic wajah (protein alpha-1 antitrypsin ki kami) se bhi COPD ho sakti hai, chahe woh smoking na karein ya aaloodgi mein na rahein.

blocks.alt: Chhote phephre jin ka ek hissa neeche bara kar ke dikhaya gaya: kati hui bronchiole ki andar ki tah moti aur soozi hui hai aur tang lumen mein mucus bhara hai; is ke sire par bare, band alveoli mein hawa phansi hui hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.14: COPD se mutasir phephra (textbook ki Figure 10.14 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Mucus, Inflamed lining of bronchiole, Trapped air, Enlarged blocked alveoli.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: COPD mein bronchiole ki sooji hui tah aur mucus rasta tang kar dete hain; saans nikalte waqt hawa poori bahar nahi nikalti aur alveoli mein phans jati hai, jis se woh phool jate hain.
Alamaat: musalsal balgham (sputum) wali khansi, saans phoolna, wheezing (saans ke saath seeti ki awaz), seene ki jakdan (chest tightness), thakan aur baar baar saans ki naliyon ke infections.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki list mein “chest” ke baad lafz chhoot gaya hai; alamat chest tightness (seene ki jakdan) hai, jaisa kitab ke chronic bronchitis wale box mein likha hai.

Ilaj: COPD ka mukammal ilaj nahi (incurable), magar dhuen, aaloodgi aur chemicals se bach kar is ka barhna sust kiya ja sakta hai. Doosre ilaj: bronchodilators (saans ki naliyan kholne wali dawaein), saans se li jane wali corticosteroids, pulmonary rehabilitation (saans ki warzish aur training) aur oxygen therapy. Kuch shadeed cases mein surgery, jaise lung transplant, par ghaur kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Chronic bronchitis
blocks.text: Chronic bronchitis bhi COPD ki ek qisam hai. Is mein lungs ki bronchial naliyon mein sozish aur tangi hoti hai. Mucus zyada banta hai jo raste mazeed band kar ke saans mushkil kar deta hai. Is ki pehchan (diagnosis) tab hoti hai jab balgham wali khansi lagatar do saal tak, har saal kam az kam teen mahine rahe; yeh aksar umar bhar rehne wali beemari hai. Yeh cigarette ke dhuen, hawa ki aaloodgi ya factory ki gard jaisi takleef deh cheezon mein lamba arsa rehne se hoti hai. Alamaat taqreeban COPD jaisi hain: wheezing, saans phoolna, seene ki jakdan aur baar baar infections. Smoking chhod kar ise control kiya ja sakta hai; doosre ilaj bronchodilators, pulmonary rehabilitation aur kuch cases mein oxygen therapy hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke chronic bronchitis “teen mahine se do saal tak” rehti hai. Yeh beemari do saal baad khatam nahi hoti; yeh COPD ki lambi, aksar umar bhar rehne wali qisam hai. Kitab ne is ki tareef (definition) gadmad kar di hai: chronic bronchitis tab kehte hain jab balgham wali khansi lagatar do saal, har saal kam az kam teen mahine rahe.

Emphysema COPD ki ek qisam hai. Is mein alveoli ki andar ki deewarein kharab ho kar aakhir phat jati hain. Is se bohat se chhote alveoli ki jagah ek badi khali jagah ban jati hai aur gas exchange ki surface area kam ho jati hai. Emphysema ki sab se badi wajah smoking hai. Hawa ki aaloodgi, gard ya chemicals ke dhuen mein lamba arsa rehna bhi wajah ban sakta hai. Alpha-1 antitrypsin protein ki genetic kami se bhi emphysema ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Ek phephra jis ke do hisse boxes mein bare kiye gaye: normal alveoli, angoor jaise guchhon mein bohat si chhoti thailiyan; aur damaged alveoli, chand bari hawai jagahen jin ki andar ki deewarein toot chuki hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.15: Emphysema (textbook ki Figure 10.15 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Deewarein tootne se bohat se chhote alveoli mil kar ek badi jagah ban jate hain, to gas exchange ki surface kam ho jati hai.
Alamaat: saans phoolna, khansi, wheezing, thakan aur seene ki jakdan.

Ilaj: smoking chhodna sab se zaroori qadam hai, kyunke smoking jari rahe to beemari tezi se barhti hai. Doosre ilaj: bronchodilators, saans se li jane wali steroids, oxygen therapy aur pulmonary rehabilitation.

blocks.prompt: Do mareezon ki saans phool rahi hai. Ek ke alveoli fluid se bhare hain; doosre ke alveoli ki deewarein toot kar badi khali jagahein ban gayi hain. Har ek ko kaun si beemari ho sakti hai, aur dono mein gas exchange kyun kharab hai?
blocks.explanation: Pehle ko pneumonia hai: alveoli mein peep aur fluid hawa aur capillaries ke beech moti rukawat ban jate hain aur alveoli mein hawa ki jagah kam ho jati hai, is liye kam oxygen diffuse hoti hai. Doosre ko emphysema (COPD ki qisam) hai: bohat se chhote alveoli mil kar ek badi jagah ban jate hain, diffusion ki kul surface area kam ho jati hai, is liye hawa pohanchne ke bawajood bohat kam oxygen khoon mein ja pati hai.

items: Upper tract ke infections qatron se phailte hain: sinusitis (aankhon ke neeche, upar, beech aur peeche ke sinuses ki sozish; zyada tar virus se) aur otitis media (Eustachian tube mein ruke fluid se middle ear ki sozish).

Lower tract ke infections: pneumonia (alveoli mein peep aur fluid; bacteria, viruses, kabhi fungi; bachon ki maut ki sab se badi infectious wajah) aur pulmonary tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis, contagious, lung mein cavities, aam tor par 6 mahine antibiotics).

COPD smoking, aaloodgi ya alpha-1 antitrypsin ki kami se lungs ki chronic sozish hai; mukammal ilaj nahi magar dhuen se bach kar sust ki ja sakti hai. Emphysema (phati alveoli ki deewarein) aur chronic bronchitis (tang, mucus bhari bronchial naliyan) is ki qismein hain.
